scope: Read-only current-user packaged Windows Terminal instance inventory

implementation.instanceVerification: Only the live current-user Get-AppxPackage query sets InstanceVerified=true; injected package records are marked InventorySource=InjectedUnverified and InstanceVerified=false.

sourceReview.basis: Microsoft documents separate per-package Stable/Preview/Canary settings paths, an unpackaged LocalAppData path, and portable settings stored beside the application.

coverage: Stable and Preview paths remain bound to separate package identities and settings files.
Missing settings files are reported without being created.
Unexpected package names are ignored; known names with mismatched package-family identities are refused.
Duplicate records for a package family are refused.
Settings above the 1 MiB inspection limit are refused.

sideEffects.testFixtures: Synthetic injected AppX records and files under Pester TestDrive.

remainingAcceptance: Connect an operator-selected inventory record to the exact-path writer and revalidate package identity before any write.
Verify the intended profile's availability and launchability in the selected instance.
Accept packaged instance discovery and file apply/recovery behavior on a disposable Windows VM.
Keep unpackaged and portable installations on explicit operator-supplied paths unless separately implemented.
